title: File the M0 AUTH batch (accounts, spend, name protection)
summary: Post every M0 authorization request as a GitHub issue using the AUTH REQUEST template, numbered from #003, and append them as Pending rows to the authorization log so the Owner can approve them together.

acceptance_tests.test: One auth-request issue per item, exact format, numbered sequentially from #003: Apple Developer Program ($99/yr), Google Play Console ($25 one-time), Unity account and plan, Luma API, Meshy and/or Tripo (per M0-LEGAL-04), Supabase (staging and production projects), Vercel, Inngest, giganticjourneys.com + .app, Mac mini vs cloud Mac, reference Android device or device-farm minutes, App Store Connect record to reserve the name, attorney review of the M0 legal drafts.
The first request includes the USPTO TESS search result for 'Gigantic Journeys' in classes 9 and 41 and a filing recommendation (kit §9).
A summary table (one-time and monthly totals versus the $750–1,300/month budget) is posted as a comment on the first issue and added to the log PR.
PR on branch auth/003-m0-batch appends the Pending rows to governance/AUTHORIZATION_LOG.md without touching the Decisions table.
